question: On DNA methylation it is true that:

options.opb: It can be mono-di- or trimethylation.
options.opc: It is introduced by enzymes called HAT.

analysis: DNA methylation typically inhibits transcription by blocking the binding of transcription factors to DNA. Methylation can occur in different forms including mono-, di-, and trimethylation. Enzymes responsible for DNA methylation are known as DNA methyltransferases (DNMTs), not HAT enzymes. HDACs (Histone Deacetylases) are involved in histone modifications, not DNA methylation.
